description: This source file defines a Java interface 'Scenario1Simple' which extends 'Scenario'. It sets up a specific scenario for testing policies related to permissions, including policy definitions and methods related to applying algorithms and retrieving scenario information. It also contains static string identifiers and a Policy object configured with subjects and permissions.

classes.name: Scenario1Simple
classes.description: A Java interface representing a specific test scenario for policies, including predefined subjects, permissions, and an associated policy object.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the static Policy object configured for this scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario group, which is a string identifier.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Provides a function that applies a PolicyAlgorithm to verify permissions on a resource, returning a boolean.
